Bill No. 82-F of 2026
THE APPROPRIATION (NO. 2) BILL, 2026 
(AS PASSED BY THE HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT)
A 
BILL 
to authorise payment and appropriation of certain sums from and out of the 
Consolidated Fund of India for the services of the financial year 2026-27. 
BE it enacted by Parliament in the Seventy-seventh Year of the Republic of 
India as follows:— 
1. This Act may be called the Appropriation (No. 2) Act, 2026.
2. From and out of the Consolidated Fund of India there may be paid and
applied sums not exceeding those specified in column 3 of the Schedule amounting 
in the aggregate to the sum one hundred sixty-two lakh eighty-four thousand one 
hundred thirty crore and six lakh rupees towards defraying the several charges which 
will come in course of payment during the financial year 2026-27 in respect of the 
services and purposes specified in column 2 of the Schedule. 
Short title. 
Issue of Rs. 
16284130,06,00,000 
out of the 
Consolidated 
Fund of India for 
the financial year 
2026-27.

2 
Appropriation. 
Construction of 
references to 
Ministries or 
Departments in 
the Schedule. 
3. The sums authorised to be paid and applied from and out of the
Consolidated Fund of India by this Act shall be appropriated for the  services and 
purposes expressed in the Schedule in relation to the said year. 
4. References to the Ministries or Departments in the Schedule are to such
Ministries or Departments as existing immediately befor e the 6th July, 2021 and 
shall, on or after that date, be construed as references to the appropriate Ministries 
or Departments as reconstituted from time to time.
